title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.66
subtitle: AETHER: sewing like Marvelous, OGC, Fit Pose, Wind, Shrink, Inflate and a Grab that slides.

highlights.title: Grab no longer freezes
highlights.description: Lifting a seam end or a corner in the Live Simulation follows the mouse; the grabbed vertex pushes the cloth in its way ahead of it.

highlights.title: Sewing like Marvelous
highlights.description: Seams close fast and in the air, the seam line no longer fights itself, and a closed seam bends like the cloth (fold angle flat).

highlights.title: Wind for AETHER
highlights.description: Force Empties blow the cloth in Live and in bakes: speed, gusts, turbulence and the same air field as the Wind preview.

highlights.title: Grab Cloth
highlights.description: No stretch limit, the cloth slides along the skin as you pull, and Grab Cloth stays on for the whole Live Simulation.

highlights.title: Fewer crossed layers
highlights.description: Cloth is moved ahead of a moving arm or leg before it gets caught, so fast motion leaves fewer layers crossed.
